title: Indoor Trainer Season Share Crosses Seventy Percent
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=intervalsicu:activity
bin _time span=1mon
stats count(eval(indoor=1)) as indoor, count as total by _time
eval indoor_pct=100*indoor/total
where indoor_pct>70
description: Alerts when Intervals.icu activities become overwhelmingly indoor trainer sessions.
value: Surfacing indoor trainer season share crosses seventy percent helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant fitness & activity tracking export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It finds when indoor trainer season share crosses seventy percent matters for your routine.
